note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: 115 customs records on ImportKey with dated bills of lading (e.g. B/L 9939082 to Shanghai 2026-02-23; B/L 9539438 to Bangkok 2026-02-10; B/L 9368100 to Genoa 2026-02-04; B/L 1084599 to Colombo 2026-02-27), all under HS 13012000, dispatched from Hazira Port Surat (INHZA1) and Ahmedabad ICD (INSBI6). Counter vs rows: page claims 115 shipments / 6 trading partners / 32 port lanes, but the free view exposes only 5 rows and 5 named ports (Hazira 7, Nhava Sheva 6, Hazira INHZA1 5, Shanghai 4, Nhava Sheva INNSA1 3) — the 115 figure is unverified beyond those 5 rows. Note the same page also lists this company as an importer (e.g. "NAGAAD TRADING LLC, SPRAY DRYING AND CHEMICALS PRIVATE LIMITED GUM ARABIC GRADE 2 ... Jebel Ali, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES ... 13012000 7498108"), i.e. it both imports raw gum and re-exports spray-dried gum — consistent with a processor/trader profile, not a pure manufacturer. Second-source cross-check failed: volza.com returned HTTP 403 and the dash-separated slug variant (spray-drying-chemicals-private-limited) returned an empty record set, so ImportKey is the single source for the shipment lines. Domestic supply: no traces found in reachable sources — this is a gap in evidence, not proof of absence; GST turnover and GeM/CPPP participation remain null and should be re-checked when search access is restored. No sanctions/court/ownership issues were assessed here (out of scope for this role).
